docs: ### Toggle A two-state button component that can be toggled on or off for formatting controls, filters, and feature toggles. **Import Path**: ```typescript import { Toggle } from "@/components/ui/toggle/toggle"; ``` #### Default Standard pressable toggle button. ```tsx const [isBold, setIsBold] = React.useState(true); Bold ``` #### Variants Choose from default styling, thin borders, or flat background presets. ```tsx Default Bordered Flat ``` #### Colors Standard color highlights matching the design system colors palette. ```tsx Default Primary Secondary Accent Success Warning Danger ``` #### Sizes Scale toggle dimensions: 'sm', 'md', or 'lg'. ```tsx Small Medium Large ``` #### Radius Apply custom border-radius rounding from completely square to circular pill corners. ```tsx None Medium Extra Large Full ```
